title: Spec Compare

emptyHint: Select a lot and click Compare to see CP vs FT spec comparison.
noSpecsTitle: No packaging specs for this product

specSource.title: Which two specs does this compare?
lines: Left: the limits carried by the CP file itself, read per lot at upload.
Right: the packaging spec set per product under Spec Management.
It compares the two sets of limits, not the die measurements.
— Unrelated to CP Review's Q1 / Q2 / Q3
